label: tab3
caption: Two-level estimates of area immigrant density and the limited-English differential, foreign-born workers
note: Dependent variable is log hourly wage. Fixed part also includes a quadratic in age, race and Hispanic origin, the remaining education categories, marital status, disability, and a quadratic in years since migration. Person weights rescaled to mean one. Standard errors in parentheses. Density slopes are for generic density in columns 1 and 2 and own-language density in column 4. No model has a singular fit. Columns 3 and 4 use the 2022–2024 window. Column 1 is the main specification, fixed before estimation. Column 4 is restricted to workers who speak a language other than English at home and was added after the main specifications were estimated (exploratory). On that subsample the column 1 specification gives limited English −0.224 (0.035), immigrant density −0.091 (0.019) and the interaction 0.055 (0.031). With occupation fixed effects, the column 4 estimates are limited English −0.078 (0.032), immigrant density −0.046 (0.008), own-language density −0.035 (0.010) and the interaction 0.021 (0.013), standard errors clustered on PUMA.
